src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_cd118_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: 2021 plan: PL 2021, c. 487 (LD 1739), signed Sep. 29, 2021, the Apportionment Commission's unanimous plan of Sep. 27, 2021, for elections beginning in 2022 (codified in 21-A MRSA sec. 1205-A by PL 2021 c. 552); 2 districts

Maine Public Law 2021, chapter 487 (LD 1739), 'An Act To Reapportion Maine's Congressional Districts': enacted and signed Sep. 29, 2021; adopts the Apportionment Commission's unanimous plan of Sep. 27, 2021 for elections beginning in 2022

The 2021 plan moves 7 Kennebec County municipalities out of the 1st District and brings in 6 others (the district text is in the chaptered act). Verified against the file: District 1 under the 2021 plan comes to 8,539.94 sq km from Census land areas, and the cb_2022 cd118 file has exactly 8,539.94 sq km.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: 2021 plan: PL 2021, c. 489 (LD 1741), signed Sep. 29, 2021, the Apportionment Commission's plan, for elections beginning in 2022 (codified as 21-A MRSA sec. 1203-C by PL 2021 c. 552); 35 districts
Maine Public Law 2021, chapter 489 (LD 1741), 'An Act To Reapportion the Districts of the State Senate': enacted and signed Sep. 29, 2021
Census cb_2022 sldu file: LSY 2022; 31 of 35 areas differ from the 2020 file by more than 0.5 percent (up to 85 percent); equals the 2024 file (max 0.1 percent).

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: 2021 plan: PL 2021, c. 490 (LD 1738), signed Sep. 29, 2021, for elections beginning in 2022 (codified as 21-A MRSA sec. 1204-C by PL 2021 c. 552); 151 districts
Maine Public Law 2021, chapter 490 (LD 1738), 'An Act To Reapportion the Districts of the State House of Representatives': enacted and signed Sep. 29, 2021
Census cb_2022 sldl file: LSY 2022; all 151 areas differ from the 2020 file by more than 0.5 percent; equals the 2024 file (one district differs by 0.7 percent, the rest within 0.1 percent).
